ov: Small carnivores of Africa, Asia and southern Europe, 34 species in two subfamilies. A large introduced population lives in Hawaii. Most have long faces and bodies, short legs, small rounded ears, long tapering tails and a grizzled coat.
rg: Africa, Asia and southern Europe; introduced to Hawaii.
df: Mainly insects, rodents, reptiles and birds.

cf.tip: The meerkat is a small mongoose from southern Africa.

fx: Its name comes from Indian languages, altered to end in “-goose” by folk etymology.
A change in one of their nerve receptors stops snake venom’s nerve toxins from binding, protecting them from it.
